Container.Name: OpenBot
Container.Overview: Unofficial Unraid image for OpenBot (openbot.run, github.com/nightly-labs/openbot), Nightly Labs' workspace for a team of AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes Agent or a model on your own Ollama server. This container runs OpenBot's official server image, so the agents, their workspaces, chats and files live on your server while the OpenBot desktop app, phone app or openbot.run/app reach it through your OpenBot account. After installing, open the Console and run openbot login. On top of the official image, it runs OpenBot as Unraid's usual 99:100 account, works with Unraid's Use Tailscale switch, and has a Tailscale setting that keeps every device connection on your tailnet instead of OpenBot's relay. OpenBot is free for noncommercial use only (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0). The first time you open the Console, it walks you through signing the server in to OpenBot and GitHub; run onboard to do it again.
Container.Requires: An OpenBot account (free, signed in with an email code) and an account or API key for each AI provider you connect. For the Tailscale setting: Unraid 7 or later, and Tailscale on every device that connects.

Config.Name: Tailscale
Config.Description: false: your devices reach this server through OpenBot's network, directly when they can and through OpenBot's relay when they cannot. true: OpenBot's Private network, so phones, computers and teammates connect only over your tailnet, and chats and files never pass through OpenBot's servers (signing in still does). With true, also turn on Use Tailscale above and approve the container from the link in its log.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Everything OpenBot keeps: its database, the agents' workspaces, provider sign-ins and the keyring that unlocks them. Back up the whole folder together, never part of it.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID OpenBot and its agents run as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID OpenBot and its agents run as.
